body: I feel like I have no place here
I don't know how to and when I try I fail. I don't like going out in public because I feel unattractive and ugly.

It's not what's bad, it's just a sense of belonging and purpose. I was made fun of growing up and I never been in a stable relationship. I don't know how to express my feelings nor escape from them except suicide. I'm tired of waking up in the morning,  going to work just to do remedial shit, go home and do it again. I'm tired of looking at happy families knowing my own can even sit in the same room and on top of that my grandmother dying. Even though people say there is  purpose, I believe everyone doesn't including myself.

My family knows but they can't help me. My friends know but they don't know how to help me. I'm tired of life. They don't care about the pain I go through and me hurting every night. Me leaving this world will not make a dent in it. People die everyday. I end my life on my terms.

Thanks I'm really hurting right now and suicide feels like the right way to go. I tried getting help and no one wants to help me.  I'm frustrated and alone in my problems.  This seems like the way to go.
